01 · About Us

Great results start with truly listening

At CM Build Solutions, we combine expert craftsmanship, premium materials, and a commitment to customer satisfaction that sets us apart. We take the time to understand each client’s needs, preferences, and expectations, so every project reflects your vision.

From small updates to complete renovations, one team handles your flooring, remodeling, lighting and electrical — with full project management from start to finish, transparent pricing and no hidden fees.

07 · FAQ

Questions, answered

Estimates are free, with no obligation. We visit your space, understand the project and give you a detailed number before you decide anything.
First we schedule a free consultation to understand your needs and evaluate your space. After the visit, you receive a detailed estimate. Once approved, we coordinate a start date and keep communication clear throughout the project.
Pricing is transparent and based on the size and complexity of each project — competitive rates with no hidden fees. For larger projects or bundled services, discounts may be available.
We accept cash, check and Zelle.
We serve the entire Tampa Bay Area and surrounding communities.
Yes — we serve clients in English, Portuguese and Spanish, whichever is easiest for you.
